title: PAN-OS authentication bypass in saml authentication
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-319.06.30.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY –  PAN-OS AUTHENTICATION BYPASS IN SAML AUTHENTICATION
leadParagraph: Paloalto reported a very critical (Severity 10) authentication vulnerability release which affects PAN-OS 9.1 versions earlier than PAN-OS 9.1.3; PAN-OS 9.0 versions earlier than PAN-OS 9.0.9; PAN-OS 8.1 versions earlier than PAN-OS 8.1.15, and all versions of PAN-OS 8.0 (EOL).
contentHtml:
Paloalto reported a very critical (Severity 10) authentication vulnerability release which affects PAN-OS 9.1 versions earlier than PAN-OS 9.1.3; PAN-OS 9.0 versions earlier than PAN-OS 9.0.9; PAN-OS 8.1 versions earlier than PAN-OS 8.1.15, and all versions of PAN-OS 8.0 (EOL).

This issue does not affect PAN-OS 7.1.

The Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (TTCSIRT) encourages users and administrators to review the Paloalto link that follow for further review and apply the relevant workarounds or updates:

https://security.paloaltonetworks.com/CVE-2020-2021
